audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: the page never names any Qiyana ability except Audacity, and it never states the interaction that decides the lane.
audit.why: Qiyana has two dashes — Terrashape (W), a 1100-range dash on 7s that also arms her element off terrain, and Audacity (E), a 650-range dash onto you on 11/10/9/8/7s. Miasma grounds both, which is why holding W for her commit rather than for the wave is the whole matchup. Supreme Display of Talent (R) is a 950-range shockwave on a flat 120s that detonates the armed element for a knockup and stun. Elemental Wrath (Q) swings at 525 on 7s for 35 mana. Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing Cassiopeia, which an Audacity landing satisfies.
audit.corrected: Every ability named with its real cooldown and range, and the grounds-both-dashes and arms-off-terrain facts written into the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabricated mechanics in the content layer: 'Twin Fang's mark execute' (late) and 'Twin Fang execute threshold' (spikes[3]) — Twin Fang has no execute; 'Q auto-attack resets' (wants.you[0]) — Noxious Blast has no auto reset; and 'her Element Blade combo' (wants.you[2]) — no such ability.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Twin Fang increased damage against poisoned targets and a heal, nothing resembling an execute or a mark. Noxious Blast is a delayed ground blast with a move-speed reward, not an attack reset.
audit.corrected: Replaced with what the kit actually says: Twin Fang hits harder into poison, Noxious Blast zones from 850, and the combo to bait is Audacity.
